item.tib: snyan rgyud bar do 'phrang sgrol chen mo thos chog bar do rang grol
item.coloph: ces pas zhi khro bar do thos grol 'di ni sprul sku tshe dbang rig 'dzin gyis 'gro mgon dam pa rang grol la snyan du rgyud/ des shar pa rnal 'byor la/ des tog gis (gi) rgyal mtshan la rgyud (brgyud/)des bru rgyal ba la rgyud des rtogs ldan nam mkha' 'od zer la rgyud (brgyud/)de nas rim par brgyud nas kun tu 'phel rgyas shog/
